metadata.detail: Read inputs/graph.json: 7 vertices (v1..v7), 9 edges (v1v2, v1v3, v2v3, v2v4, v3v5, v4v5, v4v6, v5v7, v6v7); degrees: v2,v3,v4,v5 = 3, v1,v6,v7 = 2.

Hypothesis: k = 4. Matching {(v1,v2),(v3,v5),(v4,v6)} gives lower bound 3; degree-sum argument rules out size-3 covers (only degree-3 vertices are v2,v3,v4,v5 and every triple among them contains an edge, so any 3-set covers at most 8 of 9 edges). Candidate covers: complements of independent 3-sets.

Exhaustively tested all C(7,3)=35 vertex triples for independence against the 9 adjacent pairs: exactly 4 independent 3-sets ({v1,v4,v7},{v1,v5,v6},{v2,v5,v6},{v3,v4,v7}); none extends to an independent 4-set, confirming no size-3 cover. Verified each of the 4 complement sets covers all 9 edges.
Wrote enumeration.json: k=4, 4 minimum covers, each sorted, list sorted lexicographically, complete=true.
